CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Say God’s Plan for Redemption has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing God’s Plan for Redemption.
   D. Use God’s Plan for Redemption to insult classmates of other faiths.
